verdict.rationale: Gusto documents offering health insurance through a partner (SimplyInsured) as part of its platform alongside payroll (gusto-docs-39, gusto-docs-44/52), implying integrated administration, but there's no first-party detail on enrollment workflows or deduction-sync mechanics. Hands-on community reports directly contradict smooth administration: one customer couldn't customize plans for multi-state/multi-country employees and switched providers (gusto-comm-7), and another reported a 6+ month billing mess because Gusto failed to terminate a healthcare plan correctly (gusto-comm-14). Missing for 10: detailed API/docs on enrollment and deduction-sync mechanics, and independent evidence rebutting the termination/customization failures.
